editorial:
Imagine going back to your small hometown for a funeral, only to find that the one person you never stopped loving is still there. You get to follow Slaven, who was kicked out by his dad years ago because of his secret romance with Marko, a local athlete. The whole town is on edge because the rivers are flooding, and there is this constant feeling that everything could wash away at any moment. It creates a really intense mood where you feel like the characters have to make their big life choices right now before it is too late. The chemistry between the two leads feels real and raw, making you root for them even when things get messy with the family drama.

What really works here is how the movie balances the quiet, romantic moments with the scary threat of the flood. The acting is top-notch, though some might find the middle part a bit slow. If you love stories about second chances and fighting for love against all odds, you will dig this.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the river finally breaks through the dams, forcing the town to evacuate. In the chaos, Slaven and Marko have a huge blowout fight that turns into a heartfelt confession. They decide they are done hiding and choose to leave the village together. The movie ends with them driving away as the water floods the town, showing that they finally found peace by leaving their old burdens behind.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves heart-wrenching romances and stories about family secrets.
